$reason: An option's role written on an `<ng-container>` in the reference's listbox, beside the container's own two attributes, `ngProjectAs` and `ngNonBindable`. Angular reads those two as the container's own, and the role it leaves in the consts reaches no element (`ɵɵdomElementContainerStart`, measured with `ngc` 22.2.1), so the option is a bare text. What is the container's own is taken an attribute at a time: a reader that let a container through whole for one of them passed the option.
